report: Read all 10 verses end to end against the 12-lemma candidate table; found no construction analysed two ways without the source or the ASV licensing the difference.

Suffix (הוּא) buckets: thee/thy and him/his are object vs possessive suffixes on verbs vs nouns, each rule 18; PSA.20.2 'Send thee help' realizes the possessive suffix of עֶזְרְךָ as the recast indirect object, which the verse note records.

בְּ R→Ncmsc: PSA.20.1 and 20.5 write 'in' for a locative; PSA.20.7 gives the 'of' of 'make mention of the name' to the present בְּ under rule 11 rather than to the verb under rule 44 — correct, since rule 44's supplied-preposition clause yields to a preposition of the object's own.
הַ Td→Ncmsa: 20.7 assimilated articles are unrepresented because 'in chariots / in horses' write no the; 20.9 'the King' writes one. Context-licensed.
אֱלֹהִים Ncmpc→Sp1cp: 20.5 'the name of our God' is a construct chain (rectum takes of, rule 19); 20.7 'Jehovah our God' is apposition. Not a split.

Added units checked across the chapter (the table is blind to them): 20.5 'our' before banners (rule 18 closing sentence) and 20.7 italic 'trust' (rule 34) are the only two, and no other verse folds a comparable supplied word into a neighbour.

Two single-verse judgment calls stand with their competing readings named in the unit notes: 20.4 gives 'desire' to the comparative כְּ as the ASV's rendering of the 'according to' relation (alternative: כְּ unrepresented, desire added); 20.9 fuses בְּיוֹם → 'when' as one unit headed on יוֹם under rules 30/40 rather than leaving the construct noun unrepresented beside a בְּ holding the whole word. Both are defensible under the contract as written and neither touches another verse.
BSB disagreements (20.3 Sh, 20.9 Sh, 20.4 dative לְ) are documented convention differences — paragogic/suffixal he tokens and a silenced dative under rules 32 and 40 — not errors.

Repeated notes (jussive as bare optative, construct takes supplied the, rectum takes of, possessive/object suffix, waw → But) all restate contract rules and are not recorded as conventions. Nothing here generalises beyond the contract.
